frontmatter_raw:
name: multi-llm
description: "Orchestrate plan reviews, task generation, implementation and code reviews across several LLM CLIs in parallel, or ask every model one free-text question about a plan. Use when the user says: review my plan, multi-llm, run a code review, generate tasks from a plan, implement this plan, ask the models about my plan."

name: multi-llm
description: "Orchestrate code plan reviews, task generation, implementation, code reviews and commit reviews using multiple LLM providers in parallel, or ask each model a free-text question about a plan. Use this skill whenever the user wants to review a plan with multiple models, generate implementation tasks, implement tasks with subagent delegation, review code changes against a plan, review or fix the commits they made, ask the models a question about a plan, or run any multi-model workflow. Triggers on: 'review my plan', 'multi-llm', 'run code review', 'generate tasks from plan', 'implement this plan', 'use multiple models to review', 'ask the models about my plan', 'ask a question about this plan', '--ask', 'improve my plan', 'review and apply the suggestions', 'improve the code', 'review and fix the code', 'review my last commit', 'review the last N commits', 'review this branch's commits', 'fix the issues in my last commit'."
allowed-tools:
  - Bash(uv:*)
  - Bash(PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 uv:*)
  - Bash(command -v uv)
  - Bash(ls:*)
  - Bash(grep:*)
  - Bash(diff:*)
  - Bash(tail:*)
  - Bash(dirname:*)
  - Bash(test -x:*)
  - Bash(git rev-parse:*)
  - Read
  - Edit
  - Write
  - Task
  - AskUserQuestion
  - Glob
  - Grep
argument-hint: [--review-plan|--apply-suggestions|--improve-plan|--generate-tasks|--review-tasks|--apply-task-suggestions|--implement|--review-code|--apply-code-fixes|--improve-code|--review-commits|--apply-commit-fixes|--improve-commits|--full|--ask|--status|--init] <plan_path>|[<range>] (<range>: --*-commits only) ["<question>" (required for --ask)] [--models provider:model ...] [--interactive] [--quick] [--yes] [--force] [--scope-policy expand|preserve] [--focus "<text>"|--context-plan PATH (--*-commits only)] [--dir PATH|--gitignore|--template-only (--init only)]
